name: Francesca Orlando
bioAdditions: Francesca Maria was baptized on 22 October 1794, daughter of Agostino Orlando and Maria Mollame (S1). Her parents had married on 6 May 1782 (S3). She married Francesco Moraca on 16 March 1819 (S2). Her mother, Maria Mollame, is new to the tree.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Baptism and marriage indexed; daughter Rosa's marriage and burial name her.
